tagline: Out of Wilton center on the old ridge road.
intro: Route 33, called Ridgefield Road here, leaves Wilton center and runs nearly five miles northwest to the Ridgefield line.

Wilton began in 1726 as a parish of Norwalk, forty families who wanted a church of their own, and a center grew up around their first meetinghouse. In 1802, over Norwalk's objections, it became a town by itself.

moments.title: Wilton Center
moments.text: The second meetinghouse had fallen into disrepair in under sixty years, and the third, put up on Ridgefield Road in 1790, is now the oldest church building in Fairfield County.

moments.title: Ridgefield Road
moments.text: Early settlers farmed this ridge after clearing the forest and prying out hundreds of glacial rocks, which went into the stone walls Wilton still prizes.
